svg.title: Figure 39.3 — Patchy Brood Has Multiple Causes
svg.desc: Five panels demonstrate that similar patchiness can arise from different causes and is not diagnostic by appearance alone.
svg.text: Figure 39.3 — Patchy Brood Has Multiple Causes
A similar frame-level pattern can arise from very different biological causes.
Examine egg pattern and queen history.
Quantify mites and assess virus context.
Do not diagnose from a patchy frame alone. Use cell-level morphology, colony history, Varroa measurement and validated laboratory/official pathways when needed.
